```bash

git -C <worktree.path> merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD <assessed headRefOid>
git -C <primary> worktree remove --force .worktrees/pr-210
git -C <primary> worktree prune
```

**Step 2, branch.** The PR is landed and no worktree holds the branch.

```bash
git -C <primary> worktree list --porcelain
git -C <primary> branch -D csv-export
```

**Step 3, base.** The primary is on main and tracked-clean.

```bash
git -C <primary> fetch origin
git -C <primary> pull --ff-only
git -C <primary> merge-base --is-ancestor 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978 HEAD
```

